title: Run model: run timestamps are ordered and consistent
summary: Submits a job and checks the run record times: the run started after it was submitted, completed after it started, and the manifest elapsed time agrees with completed minus started.

steps.title: Create a fresh output folder
steps.explain: A clean place for the sink.

steps.title: Submit the job through the API
steps.explain: POST /api/v1/jobs with the TOML base64-encoded, exactly as the console does.

steps.title: Wait for the run to finish
steps.explain: Polls the task result and GET /api/v1/runs until this run reaches a terminal status.

steps.title: Run COMPLETED
steps.explain: Timestamps are checked on a clean run.

steps.title: started_at is not before the submit time
steps.explain: A run cannot start before it was submitted (same machine clock).

steps.title: completed_at is not before started_at
steps.explain: A run cannot end before it starts.

steps.title: elapsed_s agrees with completed minus started (within 1 s)
steps.explain: The manifest duration must describe the same run as the record times.
